definitions.explanation: The government agency that collects duties on imports and exports and controls the flow of goods across borders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{税関|ぜいかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My luggage was inspected at the airport customs.

examples.japanese: {税関|ぜいかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もの→もの：10988_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you have anything to declare at customs?

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{税関|ぜいかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{止|と}められない→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I bought a lot of souvenirs, so I was worried about being stopped at customs.

notes:
{税関|ぜいかん} refers to the customs office/checkpoint at borders, airports, and ports where goods are inspected and duties collected.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {税関|ぜいかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧: to go through customs
- {税関|ぜいかん}⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧: customs declaration
- {税関|ぜいかん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧: customs inspection
- {税関|ぜいかん}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: customs officer

TRAVEL TERMS:
- ⟦{申告|しんこく}→申告：03687_shinkoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もの→もの：10988_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Do you have anything to declare?
- ⟦{免税|めんぜい}→免税：09706_menzei⟧: duty-free
- ⟦{関税|かんぜい}→関税：05136_kanzei⟧: customs duty, tariff
